name: Roasted Butternut Squash & Black Bean Enchilada in Mole Verde (Night 1)
whyItWorks: While the roasted butternut squash is soft, whole black beans, tomatillo-serrano mole verde, and pepita garnish make it risky.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat only the soft roasted butternut squash and corn tortilla interior, or order the Pan-Seared Red Snapper / Pollo Asado plain instead.
watchOuts: Tomatillo acidity and serrano chili in mole verde
